It may be film awards season, but Netflix hasn’t forgotten about its TV contenders. The streamer is set to throw its fourth annual “FYSee: The Fall Edit” fall awards showcase, taking place the first two weekends of November at Netflix’s Tudum Theater in Hollywood.
Among the series set to be showcased via screenings and panels are “The Altruists,” “Beef,” “The Diplomat,” “East of Eden,” “Emily in Paris,” “The Gentlemen,” “Monster: The Lizzie Borden Story,” “The Murder of JonBenét Ramsey” and “Nobody Wants This.” Related Stories Dana Carvey Says He 'Didn't Understand the Kerfuffle' Over Shane Gillis' 'SNL' Monologue: 'I Just Saw It' as a 'Joke' Inde Navarrette Takes Swipe at Shane Gillis During ‘SNL’ Monologue

The Q&As will feature both producers/creative teams from the series and stars like Kristen Bell, Julia Garner, Charlie Hunnam, Theo James, Melissa McCarthy, Charles Melton, Florence Pugh, Keri Russell, Cailee Spaeny and more.
Here’s the lineup for the events set for Friday, Nov. 6, through Sunday, Nov. 8, followed by Friday, Nov. 13, through Sunday, Nov. 15:
“Nobody Wants This” Season 3 screening with panelists: ◦ Erin Foster / Creator, Co-Showrunner, Executive Producer and Writer ◦ Jenni Konner / Co-Showrunner, Executive Producer and Writer ◦ Kristen Bell / Executive Producer and “Joanne” ◦ Justine Lupe / “Morgan” ◦ Timothy Simons / “Sasha” ◦ Jackie Tohn / “Esther” ◦ Negar Ali-Kline / Costume Designer ◦ Manish Raval / Music Supervisor
“The Altruists” Advance preview of the limited series about Sam Bankman-Fried and Caroline Ellison, followed by panel with : ◦ Graham Moore / Creator, Showrunner, Executive Producer and Writer ◦ Julia Garner / Executive Producer and “Caroline Ellison”
“The Gentlemen” Season 2 screening with panelists: ◦ Matthew Read / Executive Producer and Writer ◦ Theo James / “Eddie Horniman” ◦ Kaya Scodelario / “Susie Glass” ◦ Loulou Bontemps / Costume Designer
“The Diplomat” Season 4 screening with panelists: ◦ Debora Cahn / Creator, Showrunner, Executive Producer and Writer ◦ Janice Williams / Executive Producer ◦ Keri Russell / Executive Producer and “Ambassador Kate Wyler” ◦ Rufus Sewell / “Vice President Hal Wyler” ◦ Ato Essandoh / “Stuart Hayford” ◦ Ali Ahn / “Eidra Park” ◦ Nana Mensah / “Billie Appiah” ◦ Julie Schubert / Casting Director
“The Murder of JonBenét Ramsey” Advanced screening of the limited series about the unsolved murder case, followed by Q&A with: ◦ Melissa McCarthy / Executive Producer and “Patsy Ramsey”
“East of Eden” Limited series screening with panelists: ◦ Zoe Kazan / Co-Showrunner, Writer and Executive Producer ◦ Florence Pugh / “Cathy Ames” ◦ Christopher Abbott / “Adam Trask” ◦ Hoon Lee / “Lee” ◦ Jeb Stuart / Co-Showrunner, Executive Producer ◦ Laura Karpman / Composer
“Monster: The Lizzie Borden Story” Anthology series screening with panelists: ◦ Ian Brennan / Co-Creator, Showrunner, Executive Producer and Writer ◦ Max Winkler / Executive Producer and Director ◦ Ella Beatty / “Lizzie Borden” ◦ Charlie Hunnam / “Andrew Borden” ◦ Vicky Krieps / “Bridget ‘Maggie’ Sullivan” and “Elizabeth Báthory” ◦ Rebecca Hall / “Abby Borden” ◦ Michael Bauman, ASC / Cinematographer ◦ Paula Bradley / Costume Designer
“Emily in Paris” Sneak peek of the sixth and final season.
“Beef” Anthology series screening with panelists: ◦ Lee Sung Jin / Creator, Writer, Director, Showrunner and Executive Producer ◦ Charles Melton / “Austin Davis” and Executive Producer ◦ Cailee Spaeny / “Ashley Miller” and Executive Producer ◦ Jake Schreier / Director and Executive Producer ◦ James Laxton, ASC / Cinematographer ◦ Laura Zempel, ACE / Editor
